description: This file defines the EmpWorkExperience entity class for an ORM-based PHP application. It models work experience details for employees, including employer name, job title, dates, comments, and linkage to an Employee entity. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter/setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperience
classes.description: Entity class representing a person's work experience record in the system, including fields for employer, job title, dates, comments, internal identifier, and associated employee.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number identifier of the work experience record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number identifier for the work experience record.

methods.name: getEmployer
methods.description: Retrieves the employer name associated with the work experience.

methods.name: setEmployer
methods.description: Sets the employer name for the work experience.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the job title held during the work experience.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the job title for the work experience.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the work experience.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the work experience.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the work experience.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the work experience.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves additional comments for the work experience.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to the work experience.

methods.name: getInternal
methods.description: Retrieves the deprecated internal identifier of the work experience.

methods.name: setInternal
methods.description: Sets the deprecated internal identifier for the work experience.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee object associated with this work experience.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this work experience.
